title: Structure and ventilation of the Arabian Sea oxygen minimum zone
query: Using the supplied CMEMS global biogeochemical reanalysis monthly oxygen and nitrate and GLORYS12 monthly temperature, salinity and velocity for 2011-2020 in the western and northern Arabian Sea (47-70 E, 4-26 N), characterize the oxygen minimum zone (its depth range, horizontal extent and intensity) and its seasonal and year-to-year variability, and determine what ventilates it and along which pathways. The two products come from different model systems; account for that.
